log_level.title: log_level
log_level.description: Only logs level higher than the level selected

username.title: Petkit account username
username.description:
Fill username and password to let this plugin login the Petkit server for you. All devices of this account are discovered automatically, the X-Session and group id are fetched automatically, no packet capture needed any more.
• Leave both empty to use the captured headers instead.
• Petkit only allows one active session per account, it is recommended to use a dedicated account and share your device with it.

password.title: Petkit account password
password.description: Only used to login the Petkit server. It is never persisted to disk, only the session id is cached.

region.title: Account region (country code)
region.description: The country code of your Petkit account, sent to the login request. Defaults to CN for China mainland, HK for Asia, US for North America. If login fails, set it to your own country code, e.g. CN / HK / JP / SG / US / CA / IT ...

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The IANA timezone sent to the Petkit server, used to compute the X-Timezone and X-TimezoneId headers.

location.title: Server location, set this value corrent is very important becaus user data are not shared between servers.!
location.description:
• for China mainland users, select 'China mainland'.
• for Asia users select 'Asia'.
• for North America users select 'North America'

devices.title: Devices to control
devices.description: The device ids this plugin should control, selected in the custom settings page after a successful login. An empty array means no device is controlled, omit this field to control all devices of the account.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Optional now. Only needed when you do NOT provide the account username/password above.

DropMeal_name.title: Name of DropMeal Switch shows in HomeKit

MealAmount_name.title: Name of MealAmount Service shows in HomeKit

FoodStorage_name.title: Name of FoodStorage Service shows in HomeKit

enable_polling.title: Automatically update device status from Petkit server

polling_interval.title: Update device status interval from Petkit server.

enable_desiccant.title: enable desiccant monitor function in homekit

alert_desiccant_threshold.title: shows an alert in homekit when desiccant left days less than this value(days).

enable_autoreset_desiccant.title: enable auto reset desiccant left days.

fast_response.title:
When received a Homekit set request, return immediately, ignore the result.
this is useful when your device or homebridge has a bad internet connection.

items.helpvalue:
• Recommended way to use this plugin: fill username/password, this plugin logs into the Petkit server exactly like the Petkit app does, discovers all the devices of this account automatically, and fetches the X-Session and group id automatically. The session id is persisted to disk so it is reused after homebridge restarts, and this plugin re-login automatically when the session expires.
• Petkit only allows one active session per account, it is recommended to use a dedicated account and share the device with it from the main app.
• The captured headers mode below is only kept for backward compatibility.

• Only needed when the account login above is not used.
• At least, you must fufill the "X-Session" header set.
• This plugin will fulfill the headers with default header value that you not provide:

Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Accept: */*
X-Timezone: 8.0
Accept-Language: zh-Hans-CN;q=1, en-CN;q=0.9, zh-Hant-CN;q=0.8
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
X-Api-Version: 10.8.1
X-Client: ios(18.7.7;iPhone13,4)
X-Hour: 24
User-Agent: PetKit/10.8.1 (iPhone; iOS 18.7.7; Scale/3.00)
X-TimezoneId: Asia/Shanghai
X-Img-Version: 1
X-Locale: zh-CN
These names are shared by every device discovered from the server. Some of these name setting may not showing in Home app, you'd better leave these names blank.
